declarations.name: Probe
declarations.description: Two free-string attributes, constrained by `attrTypes` MAP overrides in from-string-config.json. Both hazards `fromString` has to survive live here: an ident that differs from its wire string, and two distinct tokens sharing one wire string.

attributes.name: presence
attributes.description: The MAP form where every ident differs from its wire string. `presenceFromString` must case on "true"/"false", never on "always"/"never".

attributes.name: fallback
attributes.description: The MAP form with a FAN-IN: `always` and `yes` both write "true". `tokenValues` accepts it (each token still writes one string), so the dedup lives in the emitter.
